sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Unlike the Red Signal Cartridge, this one does not call in an airdrop.
- Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition

- The flare is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Buried barrel cache
- Ground cache
- Weapon box (6x2)
- Weapon box (4x4)
- Weapon box (6x4)
- Weapon box (6x6)
